title: CreatePurchaseRequest
description: Body of POST /api/v1/requests. Unknown fields are rejected. String lengths for description and requester_display_name are measured AFTER trimming leading and trailing whitespace (JSON Schema cannot express this, so the servers and tests enforce it). The numeric range of unit_price (greater than 0, at most 10000000.00) is also enforced by code, not by this schema.

quantity.description: Whole number of units. Must be a JSON integer, not a string, boolean or number with a fractional part.

unit_price.description: Estimated unit price as a decimal STRING with at most 2 decimal places, so money never passes through a floating-point number. Code enforces: value greater than 0 and at most 10000000.00.

currency.description: Uppercase and case-sensitive. No conversion and no FX lookup happens in this slice.

requester_display_name.description: Synthetic display name only. This is a label, not an identity.
